# Olivo Press

> Olivo Press is an independent publisher of puzzle books and logbooks on Amazon, in English and Spanish: murder mystery logic puzzles, large print word search and gift puzzle books.

## Pages
- [Olivo Press puzzle books: murder mystery logic puzzles and word search](https://kitwisestudio.github.io/olivo-press/): Independent puzzle books in English and Spanish: Who Did It? murder mystery logic puzzles and Nurse Word Search, on Amazon.
- [Christmas murder mystery puzzle book for adults: Who Did It? Christmas Edition](https://kitwisestudio.github.io/olivo-press/christmas-murder-mystery-puzzle-book.html): Who Did It? Christmas Edition: 60 festive whodunit logic puzzles from 6x6 to 8x8 with solutions. A stocking stuffer for sudoku and mystery fans. Spanish edition: ¿Quién fue? Especial Navidad.
- [Large print word search for seniors: extra large letters, one puzzle per page](https://kitwisestudio.github.io/olivo-press/large-print-word-search-seniors.html): Olivo Press Large Print Word Search for Seniors: extra large letters in a low-vision typeface, one puzzle per page, words only forward, solutions included. $9.99 paperback.
- [What are murder mystery logic puzzles? Rules and how to solve them](https://kitwisestudio.github.io/olivo-press/murder-mystery-logic-puzzles.html): Murder mystery logic puzzles mix sudoku-style placement with a whodunit. The rules, a solving method and where to find a book of 60.
- [Nurse Word Search: a large print puzzle gift for nurses](https://kitwisestudio.github.io/olivo-press/nurse-word-search.html): Nurse Word Search has 60 large print puzzles about nursing life: a low-cost gift for nurses, nursing students and new grads.
